name: piston-push-stone
comment: A plain piston (33) at (-3,61,0) and a sticky piston (29) at (3,61,0), both facing +x (meta 5), each with a stone in front. Redstone torches (76, standing, meta 5) placed beside them at t=1 power them (BlockPistonBase.isIndirectlyPowered, BlockRedstoneTorch.isPoweringTo): updatePistonState sets meta 13 and playBlock(0) runs tryExtend, turning head and stone cells into moving blocks (36) whose TileEntityPiston progress goes 0 -> 0.5 -> 1 and lands on the third tile-entity update. The torches are removed at t=8: the plain piston retracts its head, the sticky one pulls the stone back (playBlock(1)). A third, sticky piston at (3,61,-4) gets a torch placed and removed in the same tick (t=2): it retracts while its head and stone are still moving out, so both are landed at once (TileEntityPiston.clearPistonTileEntity), the stone is not pulled back and its landing removes the head (the short-pulse block dropping). Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6) for the power.
